limitations.quote: // The final 0 can start an overlapping match.
limitations.note: The agent fixed the duplicate state encoding but also changed the match state's exits for a valid 1 and for an invalid cycle, enabling overlapping matches that the original transition table did not allow.
The rolling-history oracle assumed overlapping matches, so the exhaustive test accepted the extra matches instead of checking that the original post-match behavior was preserved.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach
limitations.note: Bundling the edit and test with a prohibited cleanup command forced both to be resubmitted, after an earlier Git failure had already forced a separate source-file read.
